sections.heading: The Location: Vientiane, the Mekong's Sleepy Capital
paragraphs: Vientiane is one of the world's more relaxed capital cities — a low-rise, Mekong-side town where the pace of life runs on Lao time. The March date is well-chosen: Laos's dry season runs from November through April, and March sits at the tail end of the cool period before the April–May heat peak. sections.heading: Getting to Vientiane
paragraphs: Vientiane's Wattay International Airport has direct flights from Bangkok, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, and several Chinese cities. The Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge connects to Nong Khai, Thailand, roughly 20km from the city centre — an overland option for runners already in northeast Thailand. Once in Vientiane, the city is compact and navigable by tuk-tuk or bicycle, and accommodation ranges from Mekong-side guesthouses to international-brand hotels.
